risks.note: The war in the Middle East has created considerable uncertainties that significantly affect the macroeconomic outlook, especially for emerging market economies, and will result in moderation in Indian economic activity in 2026-27 as already noted by the RBI. Management believes the impact is contained given the size of its operations, reasonable debt exposure at the standalone level and no direct exposure to foreign currency movements.

The Company's services are primarily aimed at the power sector, so its fortunes are closely tied to that sector; any deterioration in the power-sector outlook can affect the Company through rationalisation of IT projects and spends. Management's mitigant is that demand for electricity, being an essential service, should remain relatively insulated even if the economic environment worsens.
risks.risk: Dependence on the health of the power sector

risks.note: A key operational risk is reliance on a limited number of clients and sectors - the standalone customer base is largely comprised of internal Group entities and exports contribute nil of turnover. The Company strives to expand its client base beyond the Group as well as beyond the power sector in the future.
Keeping up with technology and related advancements is required to stay competitive; the risk is addressed through a well-structured framework that assigns ownership to monitor and mitigate risks.

The Company must attract and retain talent and ensure adequate employee utilisation to maintain profitability. Permanent-employee turnover rose to 15.64% in FY 2025-26 from 8.27% in FY 2024-25. Management believes its HR policies and processes effectively mitigate some of the employee related risks.

The Company is subject to data privacy laws and related rules and regulations that could have a material adverse effect on the business, and is also subject to labour laws. Operational risk also includes possible failure to comply with laws and regulations or to successfully meet contractual obligations including IT security and related services, leading to fines, penalties and lengthy litigations.
risks.risk: Regulatory and contractual compliance, including data privacy and IT security
